module_role: Bounded M6.3 sequence, integration, ownership and alarm context for the new NEH PCW skid.

network_architecture.literal_context: CAT6 ETHERNET FOR MODBUS TCP TO IGNITION SCADA; all controls shall be mirrored into EPICS program.
network_architecture.ownership: I&C contractor integrates the PLC system, including sequence, controls P&ID, points list, PLC and I/O hardware. Ignition SCADA development is in-house by the SLAC SCADA engineer.
network_architecture.source_boundaries: The drawing requires 100% Allen Bradley compatible PLC/I/O and CAT6 to the nearest SLAC network switch but states no controller model, I/O card/channel count, IP address, BACnet/IP topology, Modbus register map, polling rate, or individual device network address.

sequences.finding: The control system monitors system temperatures, flow and pressures.
Both pumps run continuously, 24 hours/day, 7 days/week.
PLC controls pump speed to maintain 42 PSIG adjustable differential pressure, supply versus return pressure.
If one pump fails, the other ramps up to maintain pressure.
Process-water-loop supply-temperature sensor modulates the chilled-water control valve to maintain 63°F adjustable process-water-loop temperature.
Makeup-water solenoid valve is normally open; the sequence supplies a 15-second adjustable abnormal-meter-run condition and a closed-solenoid alarm.
An alarm condition covers system-return DP below setpoint while pump is at 100% speed.

BMS alarms are named for PCW supply temperature ±5°F adjustable from setpoint, differential pressure ±5 PSI adjustable, VFD failed, pump failed, makeup water running more than 15 seconds adjustable, solenoid valve closed, and system pressure above 90 PSIG adjustable.

physical_space_sensor_count.note: This is a process-water skid P&ID, not a room thermostat/sensor plan.

sensor_and_zone_ledger.process_instrument_context: M6.3 prints temperature, pressure, differential-pressure, flow, pump alarm/current, start/stop and VFD-speed callouts. Quantities above are diagram callouts only.

factory_vs_field: M6.3 explicitly assigns all I&C components within the PCW-skid boundary to the factory, not field installation. Existing ALC I/O/control panel/WebCTRL screen and logic are demolished or rewired as specified; this is not enough to assert exact existing-device quantities.

assertions.expected: BOTH PUMPS SHALL BE RUNNING ALL THE TIME, 24 HOURS/DAY, 7 DAYS/WEEK.
THE PLC SYSTEM CONTROLS THE PUMP SPEED TO MAINTAIN 42 PSIG (ADJUSTABLE) DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE
IF ONE PUMP FAILS, THE OTHER PUMP RAMPS UP TO MAINTAIN PRESSURE.
THE CONTROL VALVE AT THE CHILLED WATER SYSTEM TO MAINTAIN 63 °F (ADJUSTABLE)
THE MAKE-UP WATER SOLENOID VALVE IS NORMALLY OPEN. THE SOLENOID VALVE CLOSES WHEN
THE PCW SUPPLY TEMPERATURE 5°F (ADJUSTABLE) ABOVE/BELOW THE SETPOINT. 2) DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE 5 PSI (ADJUSTABLE) ABOVE/BELOW THE SETPOINT. 3) VFD FAILED. 4) PUMP FAILED.

I&C CONTRACTOR TO INTEGRATE PLC SYSTEM INCLUDING: SEQUENCE OF OPERATIONS, CONTROLS DRAWINGS INCLUDING CONTROLS P&ID, POINTS LIST, PLC AND IO HARDWARE. EXCEPTION: IGNITION SCADA DEVELOPMENT WILL BE IN-HOUSE
ALL CONTROLS SHALL BE MIRRORED INTO EPICS PROGRAM.
ALL I&C COMPONENTS SHOWN WITHIN THE BOUNDS OF THE PCW SKID SHALL BE PROVIDED BY THE FACTORY, NOT FIELD INSTALLED.
